filament_notes:
YOOPAI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C for 8 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 2 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
yoopai.com product page: print speed under 300 mm/s, nozzle 190-230C, bed 35-60C, dry at 50C for 8h; made with NatureWorks Ingeo PLA. Amazon listings (titled 'PLA+ Matte', 'Matte PLA+', 'INGEO PLA+ Matte', 'Matte PLA Plus 4KG', older 'PLA Filament ... Soft Matte Finish' Old Yellow/Old Blue etc.) repeat the same values, and the Amazon 'Printing Parameters' image shows <300 mm/s, 190-230C, 35-60C, 50C 8h. Conflict: the Silver/Gold/Copper colour listings in the same Amazon family (e.g. B0DCBY1QSD) say 'Dry at 50C for 10 hours'. Diameter: yoopai.com says nothing; Amazon says +/-0.02 mm. Listing wording ('Elegant Muted Colors for Modern Designs ... art, fashion concepts, decor objects', 'Reduced Layer Lines') closely paraphrases SUNLU's Matte PLA listing, but the numbers are YOOPAI's own (SUNLU Matte PLA publishes 205-215C @50-100 / 215-245C @100-230 mm/s). Also sold as 250g Matte PLA+ starter bundles (4/8 rolls) and mixed PLA+/Matte/Silk 250g bundles.
Source: https://www.yoopai.com/products/yoopai-pla-matte-filament-1-75mm-made-with-usa-material-soft-matte-finish-reduced-layer-lines-1kg-2-2lbs
